narratives.Description: feat(design-critique): run an arc on an xBRIEF when no GitHub issue exists (analysis first)
narratives.Overview:
- Remint-3 harvest-digest succession: after blocking pain-audit on a harvest, parent MUST retract+Handoff then mint a Prefer-A Bound whose Bound-remedy list-item titles yield a new hashBoundRemedyBytes; retraction/Handoff alone never clears a rejected harvest; byte-identical lean rotation does not discharge (#5233 evaluateAccumulatedPainAuditFollowThrough); seat a later targeting pain-audit on the new digest before bind/chip
- Remint-3 P1 durable archive: parent-owned ordered record under main-checkout-resolved archive root keyed by target-id + arc-id, separate from disposable staging; retention/relocation + evaluateCompletedArcRecord post-cleanup reader; scratch staging only
- Remint-3 P1 single archive authority: parent-collected exclusive-create per-seat outboxes feed the archive; sidecar mirror-only with published read precedence; never two live SoTs; dest-relative .deft-scratch is not archive root
- Remint-3 P1 durability honesty: machine-local/single-operator supported; #5133/#5148 cross-machine deferred; single-machine no-Issues consumer may use the archive
- Remint-3 P1 write-posture pick-one: (i) critics zero in-tree writes + parent collects, or (ii) Run posture third action + allowlist under tracked-vs-working-directory in-tree; delete unused branch
- Remint-3 P2 id-model first: publish before parser accept (i) numeric reserved-range preferred or (ii) composite scheme-plus-number with stage-(a) migration; promotion ordering; disjoint from GitHub 8+ digit forms; include PainCite.deferredIssueNumber + leftover-pain refusal sites in typed migration inventory; keep-outs narrow to pain-disposition outcomes so field-type widening for brief plan-id cites is permitted
- Remint-3 P2 stage-0 file-path complete: admit file-path PostconditionArtifactClass; generalize DispatchedObligation (target-id/path; issueNumber optional/N/A); stage-(0)-available ceiling is dispatch-sha + parent-written outbox manifest, and stage (0) explicitly constructs that outbox-manifest artifact (do not defer manifest construction to archive stage (b)); add non-numeric bound-artifact id on the verdict alongside boundCommentId; include panel-handback-acceptance.ts in stage-(0) named scope as caller; parent-read binds obligation fields; comment-id path unchanged; ship-alone for #5694 only when caller+verdict-id+stage-0 ceiling+manifest construction are defined
- Remint-3 P3 locator digest: path + blob/bytes + dispatch-sha or Stop-1-embedded digest; Target-kind orthogonal to Target shape; envelope-file needs durable bytes before Stop 1; protocol state outside digested bytes; widen evaluateTargetDigestAdmission names/errors without forking
- Remint-3 P3 gate consumer: name admission entry point consuming target identity, authoritative marker, completed-arc proof, live revision via adapter over GATE_MATCH_PREDICATES; storage fields alone insufficient; discovery/recovery or concrete manual-diagnosis path; no fake GitHub labels
- Remint-3 P3 leftover brief cite: publish operator-deferred brief plan-id/path form before accept; leftover mints proposed brief or files issue when GitHub is the work system
- Remint-3 P4 same-brief harvest: in-place plan-id-keyed idempotent update; name hashBoundRemedyBytes / Bound-remedy slice-sha as the idempotence key; say what replaces Overview, plan.items, and plan.metadata when no GitHub body (carry refused-body persist only if it is a fourth distinct write); verify expected revision; retain source+result provenance; preserve plan identity; envelope-only output choice; issue:ingest unchanged
- Remint-3 promotion: archive SoT with optional link/mirror; refuse two live arcs; aliases/relocation on later filing
- Remint-3 isolation: chosen id-model ceiling; #480 on brief/envelope text; N≥3 exclusive-create outboxes parent-collected into archive
- Remint-3 stage order: (0) file-path class + obligation/ceiling/verdict-id + outbox-manifest construction + panel-handback caller; (a) id model + ThreadComment seams including PainCite migration inventory; (b) retained archive + citation grammar + ceiling-kind; (c) digest locator + gate consumer + harvest/promotion. Acceptance scenarios unchanged
- Remint-3 keep-outs: do not weaken GitHub-issue path; do not change pain/auto-stamp/citation-position decision outcomes (typed accept-set widening allowed); no non-catalog labels; no embed protocol in xBRIEF JSON; amend design-critique-brief.md + locking test for target/target-kind/ceiling-kind; keep operative relieves cites outside Bound-remedy list titles (as on this lean)
